name: sol-pi-advisor
description: Sol plans and accepts, a local Pi implementation lane develops, and a fresh Sol reviewer gives the final verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Sol directs Pi implementation and fresh Sol review.
interface.longDescription: A supervised local delivery workflow: the primary Sol task owns architecture and acceptance, a persistent Pi coding-agent session implements in an isolated Git worktree, and a fresh read-only Sol agent reviews the accepted diff.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Pi Advisor to implement this task through local Pi and fresh Sol review.
Plan in Sol, delegate implementation to Pi, verify the diff, then obtain fresh Sol review.
